request: Test all three coaching suggestions together, not one update at a time.
hypothesis: Melee-centroid target selection, cast-to-return lateral movement, and correct fountain avoidance together increase useful hook coverage and improve mean paired-bank kill margin over v14.
design: One integrated candidate versus immutable v14 in 3v3 head-to-head matches. No individual-component competitive screens or ablations. Each map runs both banks.

acceptance.screen: Complete all 48; mean paired-bank kill margin >=1; 95% seed-block bootstrap lower bound >0; zero semantic/reference or round-trip mismatches; all three mechanisms exposed.
acceptance.confirmation: Only if screen passes, complete all 96 fresh games; mean paired-bank margin >=1 and 95% seed-block lower bound >0; zero mismatches.
acceptance.retention: Retain the combined research pair only after both gates; otherwise keep baseline. No extending fixed samples based on the result.
acceptance.hosted: Local result is specific to the native mirror matchup; no league promotion without separately validated hosted transfer.

predictions.true: All three mechanisms execute and the package clears score gates.
predictions.false_or_harmful: The combination has no eligible exposure, fails the predeclared margin threshold, or increases losses.

limitations: This tests the package, not the effect of each component or a statistical interaction coefficient.
Fresh maps avoid recycling prior single-edit results.
Seed-block intervals account for both banks sharing a map.
Screen is directional and cannot rule out small gains.
Enemy visibility, movement constraints and survival can limit legal CurveHook steps.
Synchronous native decisions do not model hosted scheduling.
prior_results: E04/E05 are historical context only. Their failed individual gates do not reject E06. This user-directed package test supersedes previous one-edit-at-a-time research guidance.
